data.name: NoDesignerBlock
data.value: The file holds no form: it has no Begin block.

data.name: NotAFormRoot
data.value: {0} is not a form, an MDIForm, a UserControl or a PropertyPage, so the file's designer block is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the root block's class, such as VB.CommandButton.

data.name: MalformedLine
data.value: This line is not a Begin, an End or a property: {0}

data.name: UnbalancedBlock
data.value: {0} is never closed, so it ends where its container or the file ends.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the block or the property bag, such as Command1 or Font.

data.name: UnmatchedEnd
data.value: This line closes no open property bag, so it is skipped: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the line, such as EndProperty.

data.name: NamelessComponent
data.value: This {0} block has no name, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the block's class, such as VB.CommandButton.

data.name: NestingTooDeep
data.value: {0} is nested more than {1} blocks deep, so it is kept as text, its contents included.
data.comment: {0} is the block's name; {1} is the deepest nesting read, 2,500.

data.name: UnreadLibraryReference
data.value: The control library {0} is not named by a type library id, so its line is kept as text.

data.name: UnmodelledHeaderLine
data.value: Header line {0} does not name a control library, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the line's name, such as Reference.

data.name: UnmodelledClass
data.value: Class {0} of control {1} is not modelled, so the control is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the class, such as MSComctlLib.ListView; {1} is the control's name.

data.name: MisplacedComponent
data.value: {0} cannot hold {1}, so {1} is placed in {2}, where its position is read as written.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the component the file places it in; {1} is the component's name; {2} is the name of the container it is placed in.

data.name: InvalidValue
data.value: Property {0} in {1} has an invalid value, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the property's name; {1} is the component's name.

data.name: MissingCompanion
data.value: Property {0} in {1} cites {2}, which was not found, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the property's name; {1} is the component's name; {2} is the binary file looked for: its path beside the designer file, or its name, such as Form1.frx, when the designer file was read as text.

data.name: MissingRecord
data.value: Property {0} in {1} cites offset {2} of {3}, which holds no record the property can read, so it is kept as text.
data.comment: {0} is the property's name; {1} is the component's name; {2} is the hexadecimal offset; {3} is the binary file's name.
